title: Buying Furniture, Appliances & Home Goods When Moving to Türkiye
seoTitle: Furnishing an Apartment in Istanbul: Stores & Timelines
metaDescription: Practical 2026 guide to buying furniture, appliances, and bedding in Istanbul: IKEA, Masko, Modoko, Arçelik, Bosch, delivery times, and rental math.
quickAnswer: Furnishing an apartment in Istanbul is fastest through IKEA Turkey for flat-pack essentials and Arçelik or Bosch for white goods (often delivered and installed within 2–7 days). Custom sofas and bedroom sets from Masko or Modoko take 3–6 weeks, while unfurnished rentals typically cost 15%–30% less per month than comparable furnished flats.

body.text: Signing an unfurnished Turkish lease often surprises newcomers: unlike many Western rentals, an unfurnished flat in Istanbul usually comes completely bare—no refrigerator, washing machine, dishwasher, curtains, or sometimes even light fixtures. Planning your store mix and delivery order prevents you from sleeping on a bare floor during your first week.

Which local and international stores (IKEA, Masko, Modoko, Arçelik, Bosch) offer fast delivery?

For quick move-in essentials, [IKEA Turkey](https://www.ikea.com.tr/en/delivery-service) (with Istanbul stores in Bayrampaşa, Ümraniye, and Kartal) offers in-stock city delivery and paid [IKEA assembly services](https://www.ikea.com.tr/en/assembly-service) within days. For white goods—refrigerators, washers, dryers, and dishwashers—[Arçelik](https://www.arcelik.com.tr/yetkili-servis) and [Bosch Türkiye](https://www.bosch-home.com.tr/tr/repair) deliver from local depots and include authorized technician installation to activate your warranty.

If you want solid-wood dining tables, custom-upholstered sofas, or higher-end bedroom sets, Istanbul's two massive furniture districts—[Masko](https://www.masko.com.tr/) in Başakşehir (European side) and [Modoko](https://www.modoko.com.tr/en) in Ümraniye (Asian side, housing 350 brands)—offer unmatched selection, though most pieces are made to order rather than held in stock.
How do furnished vs unfurnished long-term rentals compare in price?

In central Istanbul neighborhoods such as Beşiktaş, Şişli, Kadıköy, and Sarıyer, furnished long-term apartments typically carry a 15% to 30% monthly rent premium over comparable unfurnished units—and often come with mismatched older furniture. For stays shorter than 12 months, paying the furnished premium usually wins once you factor in upfront purchase costs and resale losses.

For stays of two years or longer, renting unfurnished and buying your own appliances and furniture generally breaks even within 12 to 18 months—and lets you choose a proper mattress, quiet inverter air conditioning, and an ergonomic home-office setup.
What delivery and installation timelines should newcomers expect?

Appliance delivery in Türkiye works in two steps: a courier drops off the sealed box first, and you must not open it yourself. You then schedule the brand's authorized technicians—such as [Arçelik Yetkili Servis](https://www.arcelik.com.tr/yetkili-servis) or [Bosch Montaj](https://www.bosch-home.com.tr/tr/repair)—to unbox, install, and validate your warranty 1–3 days later.

Also check your building's rules before scheduling large trucks. Older walk-ups in Cihangir, Moda, or Bebek have tight staircases that require external furniture lifts (Asansörlü Nakliyat), while gated residences (Siteler) restrict moving trucks to weekday daytime windows and require advance security registration.

items: Measure your elevator interior, stairwell turns, and appliance alcoves (especially refrigerator depth) before ordering
Order white goods first so delivery and authorized technician installation align with your key handover
Never cut open boxed major appliances before the authorized brand technician arrives
Book IKEA mattresses, blackout curtains, and basic kitchen gear for day-one livability before waiting on custom Masko/Modoko pieces
Register delivery truck license plates with your building manager (Site Yönetimi) 24 hours in advance

body.text: How do you buy quality bedding and kitchenware in Istanbul?

Türkiye manufactures much of Europe's high-grade cotton textiles, making quality bedding and towels easy to source locally without importing. For 100% cotton duvet sets, bamboo towels, and everyday tableware, visit [Chakra](https://www.chakra.com.tr/) (known for bamboo-cotton linens), [Karaca](https://www.karaca.com/ev-tekstili) (cookware, porcelain, and Karaca Home textiles), [English Home](https://www.englishhome.com/), and [Madame Coco](https://www.madamecoco.com/) in any major Istanbul shopping mall.

Pay attention to Turkish bedding dimensions before buying sheets: a standard Turkish double duvet (Çift Kişilik) is 200×220 cm, while king-size (Battal Boy) runs 240×220 cm, and pillowcases are typically 50×70 cm. For specialty chef knives, cast-iron pans, or espresso gear, major malls like İstinyePark, Zorlu Center, and Emaar Square stock international kitchenware brands alongside Turkish makers.

faq.q: Do unfurnished apartments in Istanbul include kitchen appliances?
faq.a: Often no. While newer residences frequently include a built-in stovetop, oven, and extractor hood (Ankastre Set), refrigerators, washing machines, dishwashers, and dryers are almost always supplied by the tenant.

faq.q: Why shouldn't I unbox my new Arçelik or Bosch appliance myself?
faq.a: In Türkiye, major appliance brands require their authorized service technician (Yetkili Servis) to unbox and install refrigerators, washers, dishwashers, and dryers to validate the official warranty and confirm no transit damage occurred.

faq.q: Can I pay for furniture in installments with a foreign credit card?
faq.a: No. Turkish interest-free installment plans (Taksit) work only with Turkish-issued credit cards. Foreign Visa and Mastercard cards process as a single upfront charge.

faq.q: How do I get custom curtains made quickly in Istanbul?
faq.a: Neighborhood curtain shops (Perdeci) and stores in Masko or Modoko measure windows directly at your apartment and typically sew and hang sheer (Tül) and blackout (Fon) curtains within 5 to 10 days.

faq.q: Is it worth shipping furniture from Europe or the US to Türkiye?
faq.a: Rarely for standard items. High-quality Turkish furniture, mattresses, and 220V European-spec appliances are widely available locally, whereas importing household goods involves customs paperwork, port fees, and voltage/plug mismatches for US appliances.

faq.q: Where can I resell furniture if I leave Türkiye after two years?
faq.a: Expats commonly sell gently used appliances and IKEA or Mudo furniture through Sahibinden.com, Letgo, or local Istanbul expat relocation groups, typically recovering 30%–50% of the original purchase price depending on condition.
